nodes.label: TikTak API Test Console (index.html)
nodes.rationale: Dev-facing playground served from backend/public to manually exercise backend REST, Socket.IO and SSE endpoints.

nodes.label: Quick Login Account Switcher
nodes.rationale: Hardcoded seed accounts (alice/bob/carol/admin) for one-click auth during testing.

nodes.label: Postman Mini Runner Tab
nodes.rationale: Free-form request builder that auto-attaches Bearer token; Postman substitute.

nodes.label: apiRequest()
nodes.rationale: Central fetch wrapper: JSON body for POST/PATCH/PUT, auto Bearer token from localStorage, tolerant JSON parse.

nodes.label: loadAdminData()
nodes.rationale: Client-side guard replaces admin tab with access-denied panel unless currentUser.role is admin.

nodes.label: submitVideoUpload()
nodes.rationale: Uses raw fetch with FormData (not apiRequest) because multipart; then subscribes to SSE transcode progress via jobId.

hyperedges.label: Login -> token storage -> socket auth -> unread notifications
Video upload -> MinIO -> transcode -> SSE progress
Report video -> flagged queue -> admin approve/remove
